def resize(img):
    # Scale the picture down.
    # The longest side becomes one thousand pixels.
    return img

def merge(a, b):
    # Combine the two lists.
    # Keep the original order of the items.
    return a + b

    """Remove extra spaces.

    return text

    # Sort by price first.
    # Then sort by name.

    # This is fine for small files.
    return path

    return user

    # Queue the message.
